_source: driver/badline.py, 12 cpuhistory captures a board (16 for 9795_march, taken 112 frames in so the play loop is inside one 274578-cycle $1887 march). Each instructions unstolen cost is the MINIMUM delta over its own (opcode, branch taken, index page crossed) class, so the steal is exact and every instruction off a badline reads zero. samples are the distinct (frame position, opcode, steal, count) badline hits; writers the PCs whose write cycles the window caught; anchor_9630 the frame position of the marker itself; marker_gap that position less the instruction boundary the raster IRQ was taken at, by the interrupted mnemonic; irq_entry_* the same for all five of a frames raster interrupts; anchor_*/statically_decoded how far the cost models own $XXXX run anchors resolve each BA window to an instruction.
